html:
SMTO-LLM-0098 — The retry hit the total time limit you set

GUID: 5e13f411-8557-402b-8730-4dec0dfabb70
Slug: model-recovery-deadline-exceeded
Domain: LLM · Subsystem: provider

What happened

  • A total time limit is turned on for SMTO's retry attempts, and it ran out even though the model may still have been working. Earlier finished work is kept.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Settings › Setup › Model routing, open the Main card, and open Limits and recovery. Recovery deadline there is the total time limit that stopped the retry.
  2. Set Recovery deadline to 0 to remove this extra limit, or raise it to any value from 30 to 86,400 seconds, then select Save Main. At 0, a retry that is making progress is only bound by the task's own time limit.
  3. Start a new task to use the new value. Resuming keeps the limit the task started with, so it could stop the same way.

What success looks like

  • Retries finish, or keep going while the model makes progress, without this message.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't change Recovery timeout or other limits for this; they control different waits.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A recovery request ran past the configured Recovery deadline (recovery_deadline_seconds greater than 0), measured from dispatch and including startup; this is a resource limit, not evidence of stalled or repetitive reasoning.

What this means

  • The explicitly configured total recovery deadline expired from dispatch. This resource limit includes startup and can stop productive generation. It is independent of the inactivity allowance and remains active when the generation-quality check is disabled.

Why this can happen

  • A positive total recovery deadline was configured and elapsed.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the reported reason and effective settings.

How to fix it

  • Review Recovery deadline under Limits and recovery for the role in Settings › Setup › Model routing: set 0 to remove the separate recovery deadline (the task deadline still applies) or choose 30 to 86,400 seconds, then start a new task. Change Recovery timeout only if an inactivity error was reported.
  • Review Total recovery deadline in Model Configuration. Set it to 0 to disable it, or choose 30–86,400 seconds for new tasks. Increase inactivity timeouts only if inactivity was the reported cause.

Relevant SMTO settings

  • Open model settings: model-configuration / llm_recovery_deadline_seconds. Applies to: new task.
  • Start a new task after changing this setting. Active and resumed tasks retain their captured values.

Retry and execution caution

  • Explicit Resume starts a fresh episode and retains completed tool receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • Recovery finishes before the configured total deadline, or runs with that deadline disabled.

What not to do

  • Do not change an unrelated timeout, budget or policy. Check whether the named setting applies only to a new task.

Technical notes

  • The current decision is rejected before tool authorization when enforcement applies; earlier results are not replayed.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
